patthana15.3:1.1: hetuṃ vipākaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na vipāko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. tīṇi,
patthana15.3:2.1: hetuṃ vipākadhammadhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na vipākadhammadhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. tīṇi, na hetuṃ neva vipāka
patthana15.3:3.1: na vipākadhammadhammaṃ paṭicca na na hetu na neva vipāka na vipākadhammadhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. tīṇi.
